links.outcome: Reproducibility of ChatGPT answers to same guideline questions across repeated runs 14 days apart
links.effect: Binary queries: 8 of 11 non-compliant responses unchanged, 3 rectified, 6 initially compliant became non-compliant. Multiple-choice: 43 (86%) stayed correct, 4 stayed incorrect, 3 correct became non-compliant.
links.quote: Conversely, 6 initially compliant answers transitioned to non-compliance after 14 days.

screen.reason: The study evaluates the accuracy and temporal consistency of ChatGPT-4 answers to guideline-based thyroid nodule questions without testing any deployment safeguard or practice.
